title: SSL/TLS Inspection & Decryption Rollout (Netskope)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (decryption policy + certificate deployment + bypass management within Netskope; live-traffic sensitivity).
Netskope console internals are deferred to Netskope's official documentation (no fabricated menus); authored at the correct architectural/procedural level.
hook: See into encrypted traffic — safely, without breaking the apps that can't be decrypted
problem: Almost all web traffic is encrypted, so without inspection your secure web gateway is largely blind. But turning on decryption carelessly breaks certificate-pinned apps and creates privacy and compliance problems. This solution delivers a safe SSL/TLS inspection and decryption rollout in Netskope — deploy the inspection certificate via Intune, build decryption policy with the right do-not-decrypt bypasses (banking, health, pinned apps), and validate before enforcing.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — why decryption matters, how Netskope SSL/TLS inspection works, the inspection certificate trust chain, decryption policy and do-not-decrypt bypass categories, and privacy/compliance considerations.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Netskope tenant + SWG, the inspection certificate, Intune for cert deployment, a bypass list source, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: deploy the inspection certificate to endpoints, build decryption policy and bypass lists, steer pilot traffic, validate apps and user experience, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — certificate/decryption-readiness discovery, certificate-trust and decryption validation, a decryption coverage and bypass report, safe remediation (deploy/repair cert), and a target group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A safe SSL/TLS inspection and decryption rollout in Netskope — deploy the inspection certificate via Intune, build decryption policy with the right do-not-decrypt bypasses, and validate before enforcing. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A safe SSL/TLS inspection and decryption rollout in Netskope — deploy the inspection certificate via Intune, build decryption policy with the right do-not-decrypt bypasses, validate before enforcing.
meta_description: Roll out Netskope SSL/TLS inspection: deploy the inspection certificate via Intune, build decryption policy and do-not-decrypt bypasses, validate before enforcing. Self-guided, tested steps and scripts (Netskope specifics deferred to vendor docs).
bottom_line: Encrypted traffic made inspectable — the inspection certificate trusted on every device, decryption policy enforced with the right bypasses for pinned/sensitive apps — proven on a pilot before you scale.

hero.tagline: DECRYPT WHAT YOU SHOULD.  BYPASS WHAT YOU MUST.
